title: Geolocation
description: Origin and destination locality codes under a DECLARED geocode standard — where an order originates and terminates. Composed for ANY modality and BOTH physical and digital value chains: a shipment route (cell-grid codes: geohash, H3, S2, Open Location Code), a service jurisdiction or digital-delivery territory (jurisdiction codes: ISO 3166-1/-2, UN/LOCODE; endpoint territory in digital chains is evidenced per RFC 8805/9632 geofeeds). The standard is the source of truth — referenced, never restated; the axis is OPEN (any standard, existing or future). Carries no physical-shipment assumption; mass and volume live in the elective figaro-cargo clause.

fields.name: geocodeStandard
fields.label: Geocode standard
fields.description: The encoding standard the origin/destination codes are written in — an OPEN axis like every standards field (emissions' methodology, cold-chain's monitoring standard): any non-empty declaration is valid; frontends enhance the standards they know. Known examples: geohash (the built frontend's default), h3, s2, olc (Plus Codes) for cell grids; iso3166-1, iso3166-2, unlocode for jurisdiction-grade locality (digital-delivery territories, service jurisdictions).

fields.name: origin
fields.description: Origin locality code, written in the committed geocodeStandard. A transaction particular, filled at checkout like every field named in no fills list. Commit LOCALITY grain, never door grade — the privacy rule is doctrine across standards (geohash ≤6 chars = neighborhood; jurisdiction codes are coarse by nature); door-grade location travels the encrypted address channel (the ecdh-address interaction), never a committed field.
fields.label: Origin

fields.name: destination
fields.description: Destination locality code, written in the committed geocodeStandard. A transaction particular, filled at checkout (a frontend may fill it from the device location where the standard supports it); the composed clause is generic. Commit LOCALITY grain, never door grade; door-grade travels the ecdh-address channel.
fields.label: Destination
